input.summary: Add numbered Subparagraph 4.10 warranty with repair/replacement or refund remedies and carve it out of the Paragraph 4.9 disclaimer.
input.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 4.9 currently disclaims all warranties, leaving us with no conformance commitment or remedy. We have added a short fallback-level warranty as new Subparagraph 4.10 (90 days for software, 30 days for services) with repair, replacement or refund, and carved it out of the 4.9 disclaimer so the two provisions do not conflict.

ops.oldText: The Parties recognize and agree that the PG does not make any representations or warranties
ops.newText: The Parties recognize and agree that, except as expressly provided in Subparagraph 4.10, the PG does not make any representations or warranties

ops.oldText: the Parties hereby agree that nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as such a warranty or guarantee
ops.newText: the Parties hereby agree that, except as expressly provided in Subparagraph 4.10, nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as such a warranty or guarantee

ops.text: 4.10 The PG warrants to each other Party that (i) any software supplied in connection with APCN 2 will conform to its documentation for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, and (ii) any services performed by the PG will be free from defects for a period of thirty (30) days following performance. The remedy for breach of this warranty shall be repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or services, or a refund of the fees paid for them.
